prompt:
Goal GOAL_DATA_SAFETY (Keep credentials and sensitive request content out of observability artifacts)
Feature FEAT_SENSITIVE_DATA_PROTECTION (Sensitive-data protection)
Requirement REQ_SENSITIVE_DATA_PROTECTION (Sensitive observability artifacts exclude protected values): Runtime diagnostics and recorded provider traffic shall not persist provider credentials, sensitive request content, or sensitive tool arguments.
Technical requirement TREQ_RUNTIME_LOG_SAFETY (Runtime diagnostics expose only safe metadata): Runtime logging and public execution failures shall expose only bounded safe metadata. Provider-supplied error text, credential values, request contents, tool arguments/results, caller schema identifiers, and schema-invalid values shall not be copied into diagnostic artifacts or public failure messages.
Its verification criteria: Provider request log context exposes only declared safe identifiers and cannot contain credentials, messages, provider kwargs, schema data, or tool payloads.; Provider-controlled error text, credentials, and prompt content are absent from the public error and every retained runtime log field while safe status/type metadata remains.; Prompt, credential, tool arguments, and tool-cause text are absent from the public tool failure and every retained runtime log field while safe tool/type metadata remains.; Schema-invalid values, caller schema identifiers, credentials, and validation detail are absent from the public exhausted-repair error and every retained runtime log field.
The original version of ProviderRequest.log_context:
    def log_context(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        """Return common safe fields for provider and capability logs."""
        context: dict[str, object] = {
            "request_id": self.request_id,
            "provider": self.provider.value,
            "model": self.model.value,
            "key_id": self.credential.key_id,
        }
        if self.route_index is not None:
            context["route_index"] = self.route_index
        return context

structured.reason: When key_id is falsy (for example 0 or ""), the mutant puts the raw credential value into the provider log context. TREQ_RUNTIME_LOG_SAFETY explicitly says log context cannot contain credentials, so the mutant breaks the requirement.
structured.test_focus: Build a ProviderRequest whose credential has a falsy key_id (0 or "") and a distinctive secret value. Check that no log_context() value contains or equals the secret, and that key_id is still reported as the original key_id.
